mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_documents ( school_id, title, category, source_department, source_url, published_at, effective_at, expires_at, status, content_hash, raw_content ) values ( #{schoolId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{sourceDepartment}, #{sourceUrl}, #{publishedAt}, #{effectiveAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{status}, #{contentHash}, #{rawContent} )
mapper.select: select id, school_id, title, category, source_department, source_url, published_at, effective_at, expires_at, status, content_hash, raw_content, created_at, updated_at from knowledge_documents where school_id = #{schoolId} and content_hash = #{contentHash} limit 1
select * from knowledge_documents where id = #{id} and school_id = #{schoolId}
select * from knowledge_documents where id = #{id} and school_id = #{schoolId} for update
mapper.sql: where d.school_id=#{schoolId} and d.status='PUBLISHED' and not exists(select 1 from knowledge_document_versions v where v.supersedes_document_id=d.id) and (d.title like #{pattern} escape '!' or d.category like #{pattern} escape '!')
mapper.select: select d.id,d.title,d.category from knowledge_documents d order by d.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select id, school_id, title, source_department, source_url, status, content_hash from knowledge_documents where school_id = #{schoolId} and status = 'PUBLISHED' and ( (#{sourceUrl} is not null and source_url = #{sourceUrl}) or title = #{title} ) order by id desc limit 10

select candidate.* from knowledge_documents original left join knowledge_document_versions origin_version on origin_version.document_id = original.id left join knowledge_document_versions candidate_version on candidate_version.root_document_id = coalesce(origin_version.root_document_id, original.id) inner join knowledge_documents candidate on candidate.id = coalesce(candidate_version.document_id, original.id) and candidate.school_id = original.school_id where original.id = #{id} and original.school_id = #{schoolId} and candidate.status = 'PUBLISHED' and (candidate.effective_at is null or candidate.effective_at <= current_timestamp) and (candidate.expires_at is null or candidate.expires_at > current_timestamp) and not exists (select 1 from knowledge_document_versions successor where successor.supersedes_document_id = candidate.id) order by coalesce(candidate_version.version_number, 1) desc, candidate.id desc limit 1

select document.id, document.school_id, document.title, document.category, document.source_department, document.source_url, document.published_at, document.effective_at, document.expires_at, document.status, document.content_hash, document.created_at, document.updated_at, coalesce(version.version_number, 1) as version_number, exists(select 1 from knowledge_document_versions successor where successor.supersedes_document_id = document.id) as has_successor from knowledge_documents document left join knowledge_document_versions version on version.document_id = document.id where document.school_id = #{schoolId} order by document.updated_at desc, document.id desc limit 100

select document.id, document.school_id, document.title, document.category, document.source_department, document.source_url, document.published_at, document.effective_at, document.expires_at, document.status, document.content_hash, document.created_at, document.updated_at, coalesce(version.version_number, 1) as version_number, exists(select 1 from knowledge_document_versions successor where successor.supersedes_document_id = document.id) as has_successor from knowledge_documents document left join knowledge_document_versions version on version.document_id = document.id where document.school_id = #{schoolId} and document.id < #{beforeId} order by document.id desc limit 100

select document.id, document.school_id, document.title, document.status, document.published_at, document.created_at, version.version_number from knowledge_document_versions version inner join knowledge_documents document on document.id = version.document_id where version.root_document_id = #{rootDocumentId} and document.school_id = #{schoolId} order by version.version_number desc
mapper.update: update knowledge_documents set published_at = #{after.publishedAt}, effective_at = #{after.effectiveAt}, expires_at = #{after.expiresAt} where id = #{before.id} and school_id = #{before.schoolId} and status = 'PUBLISHED' and content_hash = #{before.contentHash} and ((published_at = #{before.publishedAt}) or (published_at is null and #{before.publishedAt} is null)) and ((effective_at = #{before.effectiveAt}) or (effective_at is null and #{before.effectiveAt} is null)) and ((expires_at = #{before.expiresAt}) or (expires_at is null and #{before.expiresAt} is null)) and not exists (select 1 from knowledge_document_versions successor where successor.supersedes_document_id = #{before.id})
update knowledge_documents set status = #{status} where id = #{id} and school_id = #{schoolId} and status = #{expectedStatus}
